_comment: Coverage expansion backlog, derived from GSC reader queries and the diversification principle: add more BRANDS and YEARS before adding more RAV4 years. Every target needs real OEM manual data before it is signed off and published — the site's sourcing standard is not relaxed for coverage. Status values: pending-sourcing (no data yet), partial (some data, not sign-off ready), ready (data complete, awaiting sign-off), live (published).
principle: Diversify brands and years per reader demand; do not pile further years onto RAV4.
readerSignals: honda crv 2024 tire size — 6 impressions @ pos 16.6 (highest-leverage reader query; CR-V hub is 404 so the page gets no internal link equity)
2026 honda civic sport 2.0l oil capacity — @83 (content gap: no 2026 page exists)
2020 toyota rav4 oil capacity / 2.5 oil capacity — pos 8-10 (RAV4 hub catches the year queries)
2009 rav4 oil capacity, 2021 rav4 oil capacity — hub catch (years pre-2022 had no page at crawl time)
Generic 'X oil capacity' / 'X tire size' patterns across many makes — demand is broad, not RAV4-specific
